title: Periodic families in the homology of $GL_n(F_2)$
summary: We construct infinite families of nonzero classes in $H_d(GL_n(F_2);F_2)$ along lines of the form $d =\frac{2}{3}n +$(constant), thereby showing that the known slope $\frac{2}{3}$-stability for these homology groups are optimal. Using the new stability Hopf algebra perspective of Randal-Williams, our computations in addition recover the slope-$\frac{2}{3}$ stability for $GL_n(Z)$ with coefficients in $F_2$, improve that for $Aut(F_n)$ to $\frac{2}{3}$, and demonstrate that those slopes are optimal.
